job: See everything about one entity on one page, and act on it, even when one part fails to load.
purpose: A record hub for one team: a head with its status and actions, the lifecycle tracker, usage meters, open requests, recent activity, a details panel and plan cards. Each section is its own fd-states and settles on its own; one in error shows Retry while the rest render. Plan moves and suspending are held in a toast; suspending then offers Done · Undo.
useWhen: One customer, team, key or project needs a single page that gathers its state, history and actions.
The sections come from different services that can fail independently.

avoidWhen.when: The page is a list of many such records.
The page exists to decide one request about the entity.
The page edits the entity's settings.

states.name: one section fails
states.how: the default: the activity fd-states settles on error with Retry

states.name: suspended
states.how: the menu's Suspend team, held, then fd-status data-tone="danger"
